_comment: Cross-SDK proof parity golden (XR-002). This file is committed byte-identical in invariance-typescript (src/resources/fixtures/) and invariance-python (tests/fixtures/). Each SDK's parity test re-derives canonical/hash/signature from `payload` using a known test key and asserts the result equals the pinned values below, then asserts the signature verifies. Ed25519 (RFC 8032) is deterministic, so a given key+message yields one signature across @noble/ed25519 (TS) and PyNaCl (Python). Drift between the two copies means signatures issued by one SDK won't verify under the other.

algo.canonical: JSON with recursively lexicographically-sorted keys, compact (no whitespace), arrays preserve order, null kept, undefined/None omitted
algo.signature: ed25519 over the 32 raw bytes of the hash digest; keys and signature are lowercase hex
algo.key_format: 32-byte raw keys as 64-char lowercase hex; signature is 64 bytes as 128-char lowercase hex
